contentText:
Daniel Thomas / Financial Times :

X settles a long-running legal battle with the World Federation of Advertisers, ending a case that accused brands like Mars and Shell of illegally boycotting X   —  Billionaire had accused brands of organising an illegal boycott  —  Elon Musk's X has settled a long-running legal battle …
